The Women's Health Initiative study found that a 20% increase in protein intake (12% lower risk of frailty) was associated with improvements in physical performance.
turns.rebuttal: While the Women's Health Initiative study suggests a potential link between increased protein intake and improved physical performance, it is essential to consider the broader context of nutritional care in older adults. Furthermore, the study's results should not be taken out of context, as they were conducted in a specific population and may not generalize to all older individuals.
